Eviction Junk Removal & Deep Cleaning in Houston, Texas

T&C Integrity & Reliable Trash Services is Houston's premier provider of eviction junk removal and professional deep cleaning services. We help property managers, landlords, real estate investors, and homeowners across Houston and Harris County turn over properties quickly and affordably.

Houston's massive rental market — with over 600,000 rental units across the metro — means eviction cleanouts are a constant need. When tenants leave behind furniture, trash, personal belongings, and damaged property, T&C Integrity handles the entire cleanup process: junk removal, hauling, deep cleaning, and sanitation — all in a single visit.

Houston Eviction Junk Removal FAQ

Quick answers about our eviction cleanout and deep cleaning services in Houston, TX.

items.title: How much does eviction junk removal cost in Houston, TX?
items.content: Eviction junk removal pricing in Houston depends on the volume of items, property size, and services needed. T&C Integrity provides free, no-obligation on-site estimates with transparent, upfront pricing. Most single-unit eviction cleanouts range from $300-$1,500 depending on scope. Multi-unit and complex jobs are quoted individually. We never charge hidden fees — the price we quote is the price you pay.

items.title: How fast can you do an eviction cleanout in Houston?
items.content: T&C Integrity offers same-day and next-day eviction cleanout service in Houston, TX. Most single-unit cleanouts are completed within 24-48 hours of booking. For multi-unit properties or large-scale cleanouts, we provide a detailed timeline during your free estimate. For urgent situations, call us directly at (555) 123-4567 for priority scheduling.

items.title: Do you offer deep cleaning after junk removal in Houston?
items.content: Yes. T&C Integrity is one of the few companies in Houston that offers both junk removal and professional deep cleaning as a combined service. Our deep clean includes kitchen degreasing, bathroom sanitization, floor cleaning, wall washing, carpet shampooing, odor removal, and vent cleaning. This means one team, one schedule, and one invoice — saving property managers time and money while ensuring the unit is completely turnover-ready.

items.title: What areas of Houston do you serve?
items.content: T&C Integrity serves all of Houston, TX and surrounding areas in Harris County. This includes Downtown, Midtown, Montrose, The Heights, Galleria, Memorial, Spring Branch, Sharpstown, Westchase, Greenspoint, Gulfton, Alief, Bellaire, Meyerland, Third Ward, East End, and all other Houston neighborhoods. We also serve nearby cities including Sugar Land, Missouri City, Katy, and Cypress.

items.title: Are you licensed and insured for junk removal in Houston, TX?
items.content: Absolutely. T&C Integrity & Reliable Trash Services is fully licensed, bonded, and insured with general liability and workers' compensation coverage. All crew members are background-checked and professionally trained. We carry proper disposal permits for Harris County and comply with all City of Houston regulations for waste hauling and disposal.

items.title: What do you do with items removed from Houston properties?
items.content: T&C Integrity is committed to eco-friendly disposal. We donate usable items to local Houston charities and shelters, recycle materials at appropriate facilities, and only send items to the landfill as a last resort. We can provide disposal documentation and donation receipts upon request.

items.title: Do you work with property management companies in Houston?
items.content: Yes — property managers are among our primary clients in Houston. We offer volume discounts for multiple units, priority scheduling, before/after photo documentation, and dedicated account support for property management companies. Whether you manage 5 units or 500, we scale to meet your needs.

items.title: What is included in a post-eviction deep clean in Houston?
items.content: Our Houston post-eviction deep cleaning includes: full kitchen degreasing (cabinets, appliances, counters, backsplash), bathroom sanitization (toilets, tubs, tile, grout, mirrors), all floor surfaces (sweep, mop, vacuum), wall and baseboard washing, interior window cleaning, carpet shampooing and stain treatment, odor removal and deodorizing, light fixture and vent cleaning, and final inspection walkthrough.
